description: This PHP class defines a console command named 'CrowdinCommand' that interacts with the Crowdin API to fetch contributor data and optionally updates the README.md file with this information. It handles command configuration, execution, and reading from the Crowdin API, parsing CSV data, and file manipulation.

classes.name: CrowdinCommand
classes.description: A console command class for importing Crowdin project data and updating project documentation.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command name, description, options, arguments, and help message.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method that runs the command, retrieves configuration, and calls the readme method if needed.

methods.name: readme
methods.description: Fetches contributor data from Crowdin API, processes CSV data, displays contributors, and optionally updates the README.md file.
